body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-09-21

Monday. Summit AZ: plan review, emergency page fixes and internal links.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Reviewed the outside "SEO Low-Hanging Keyword Growth Plan" against the live site: approach sound, but some items already fixed, some touch the homepage (needs Scott) and it misses GBP. Kept the parts that fit.
- Rewrote claims on all 10 emergency city pages that promised after-hours, late-night, holiday, "2 AM" and flat-rate service while showing Mon to Sat 8 to 5. FAQ now says "Contact us for a free estimate"; Gilbert no longer promises "within the hour". Hours confirmed with Kim: Mon to Sat 8 AM to 5 PM, Sunday closed.
- Fixed "Apache Junction" on the Fountain Hills emergency page.
- Added 5 internal links to near-page-one pages (Fountain Hills and San Tan Valley general plumbing, sewer page to Mesa sewer repair, water softeners to San Tan Valley softener install). Fixed a typo on the sewer page.
- Indexing: 1 page requested before the daily limit; 13 scheduled for 10 PM Sep 22.
- No titles, metas or homepage content changed. Logged in the SEO change log.

# Follow-ups
- Sep 22 10 PM: confirm the 13 scheduled indexing requests ran (keep Claude app and Chrome open).
- Oct 2: review rankings for Mesa sewer, Fountain Hills drain and sewer, San Tan Valley water softener.
